summary: LCI Industries entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Patrick Industries and two merger subs. Under the terms, each LCI share will be converted into 1.2440 shares of Patrick common stock (stock consideration). Post-closing, pre-merger Patrick shareholders will own about 52% of the combined entity; LCI shareholders the remainder. Both boards unanimously approved the transaction. The deal involves a two-step merger structure, with First Merger Sub merging into LCI, then the surviving entity merging into Second Merger Sub. Watch for shareholder votes, regulatory clearances, and the exchange ratio adjustment mechanics.
